concurrentWork: Other repository validation and a separate sustained cache process ran concurrently; timing is local regression evidence, not an isolated throughput qualification. Process RSS is per executable instance.
measurementScope: one shared cache; 1/2/4 scopes and 20 fixed keys per scope; exact finite refresh, eviction, TTL, invalidation and subscriber recovery rounds; separate accounted bytes and actual process RSS; no fleet or 30-minute qualification inferred
peer: offline fixed-key cache/broadcast scripts; no credentials or sockets
qualification: Existing HTTP policy or cache/broadcast regression only; does not measure Part 8 ingress, routing, durable admission, live Discord or fleet capacity.
toolchain:
Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1 clang-2100.3.34.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0
